fieldData.awb---integration-feature-1:
Every car accident case reaches Wendell by email

Elodie Marsh was rear-ended on Oct 28 and booked a first visit at Sorrel Ridge Chiropractic. Her yes to the car accident question opens four more: the accident date, her auto insurer, the claim number, and her attorney. The intake goes by email to case coordinator Wendell Kim instead of the health plan queue.
fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { newPatients: "I run Larchmont Chiropractic. Build a chiropractic intake form that goes out with every new booking. Ask patients to tap each spot that hurts on a front and back body chart, rate it from 0 to 10, say when it started and what they were doing, and pick what makes it worse. Email the chiropractor when the intake is ready, and keep the answers in the app for the exam.", carAccidentCases: "Build an intake for Sorrel Ridge Chiropractic that asks whether a car accident caused the pain. On a yes, ask for the accident date, the auto insurer, the claim number, and the attorney, if there is one. Send those intakes by email to my case coordinator, Wendell Kim, instead of the health plan queue.", treatmentConsent: "My clinic is Bellmoor Chiropractic. Put our consent to care on the last screen of the intake and have patients sign it on their phone with a finger. Save the signature with the time it was signed, and show the front desk a list of today's first adjustments with whether each consent is signed.", reExams: "Build a re-exam form for Quarry Hill Chiropractic that sends the pain questions from the intake again at visit 12: the neck pain rating from 0 to 10 and how many minutes the patient can sit at a desk before it hurts. Show the chiropractor the intake answers and the visit 12 answers side by side." };
fieldData.afb---how-to-step-7-des: Book a made-up new patient, fill in the intake on a phone, and report a car accident as the cause. Check that the case coordinator gets the email, the consent shows as signed, and the pain answers land in the patient record.
